mechanism: Isoniazid is a CYP2C19 inhibitor that may increase cenobamate plasma concentrations, while cenobamate induces CYP3A4 and may reduce isoniazid efficacy; additive CNS depression risk also present.
action: Monitor cenobamate levels and clinical effects; consider cenobamate dose adjustment if needed; monitor for isoniazid efficacy and adjust dosing accordingly; counsel on CNS depression risk.
